login.help: Copy Claude Code's sign-in from a computer where it works to another computer of this realm.
login.title: Copy Claude Code's sign-in
login.subtitle: The file is copied as it is, readable only by its owner. You see what changes before anything is written.
login.subject: the sign-in copy to {{to}}
files.help: Copy Claude Code's settings, agents, commands and skills to another computer of this realm. Sign-ins and chats are never copied.
files.title: Copy Claude Code settings
files.subtitle: At most 200 files and 8 MiB. You choose which existing files are replaced.
files.subject: the settings copy to {{to}}
noRealm: Choose one realm from the realm menu at the top (on a phone, tap the realm square) to copy between its computers.
noComputer: Choose a computer in the top bar first.
to.none: There is no other computer in this realm to copy to.
to.notHere: The copy can't go to this computer itself or to the computer it is read from.
what.settingsNote: The ~/.claude folder: settings.json, CLAUDE.md, keybindings.json, agents, commands, skills, output styles and hooks.
path.help: For example .claude/settings.json. No leading / and no ..
path.helpHome: Type it, pick it from the list or Browse.
path.elsewhere: Only this computer's files are listed: type the path.
path.bad: Use a path below the home folder: no leading / or ~, and no .. or empty parts.
preview.noAnswer: There was no answer, so nothing is planned. A preview never writes. Preview again.
preview.bad: The computer's agent answered with something this page can't read, so nothing can be copied from it.
preview.checkFailed: {{to}} couldn't be checked, so the earlier copy may still have reached it.
plan.expired: This preview has expired. Preview again to see what would change now.
plan.changed: The inputs changed, so the preview was dropped. Preview again.
login.absent: {{to}} has no Claude Code sign-in yet.
login.present: {{to}} already has a Claude Code sign-in. Copying replaces it.
login.unknown: Whether {{to}} already has a Claude Code sign-in couldn't be checked. Copying replaces one if it is there.
login.done: Copied. Claude Code on {{to}} is signed in with this account.
login.doneReplaced: Copied. The sign-in on {{to}} was replaced.
login.notOwnerOnly: The file was copied, but it couldn't be made readable by its owner only. Check its permissions on {{to}}.
files.label: Files this would copy
files.consentNote: Existing files are kept unless you tick Replace. Files that couldn't be checked are treated as existing.
files.nothing: Every file already exists on {{to}} and none is ticked to be replaced, so nothing would be copied.
stale.expired: The preview expired before the copy. Nothing was written. Preview again.
stale.unknown: The agent no longer knows this preview (it may have restarted). Nothing was written. Preview again.
stale.changed: Something changed on one of the computers since the preview. Nothing was written. Preview again to see it now.
stale.target: A sign-in appeared on {{to}} since the preview. Nothing was written. Preview again.
toast.title: Your change to {{subject}} may have gone through
toast.body: The page closed before the agent confirmed it. Preview again before you copy again.
pending.title.login: The sign-in may have been copied
pending.body: The answer was lost, so some or all of it may be on {{to}} now. It won't be sent again. Preview again to see what is there.
pending.unreadable: The agent's answer couldn't be read, so some or all of it may be on {{to}} now. It won't be sent again. Preview again to see what is there.
refused.title: Not copied
why.source_empty: There is nothing to copy there. For a sign-in, sign in to Claude Code on that computer first.
why.source_read_failed: The files couldn't be read on the computer they come from.
why.source_too_large: The file is too large to copy.
why.cap_exceeded: That is more than 200 files, more than 8 MiB in all, or a file over 2 MiB.
why.walk_incomplete: Part of the folder couldn't be read, so it can't be copied.
why.credential_requires_import: That is a sign-in file. Copy it with Copy sign-in instead.
why.path_unsafe: The path must be below the home folder, without a symbolic link on the way.
why.not_remote: The copy can't go to the computer this agent runs on.
why.cross_realm: The two computers aren't in the same realm.
why.overwrite_not_planned: The copy asked to replace a file the preview didn't show as existing. Preview again.
why.notAllowed: This computer's access settings don't allow copying Claude Code files.
need.to: Choose the computer to copy to.
need.path: Enter the path of the file or folder to copy.
need.file: This is a folder. Pick a file in it, or choose Folder above.
need.consent: Tick the box to replace the sign-in on {{to}} first.
